source.requirement_text: Complete at least 60 semester (90 quarter) transferable units; complete a minimum of 30 semester (45 quarter) units of courses equivalent to general education requirements with a grade of C- or better, including all of the Golden Four: oral communication, written communication, critical thinking and mathematics/quantitative reasoning; have a grade point average of 2.0 or better in all transferable units attempted (2.4 for non-California residents); be in good standing at the last college attended.
source.note: Summarized from the CSU's published upper-division transfer requirements. Campuses and impacted majors may set higher or additional criteria; confirm on Cal State Apply and with the campus.

scope.note: A CSU admission minimum for upper-division transfer, not a GE certification and not a UC requirement. The four areas use Cal-GETC numbering; which courses count comes from each college's own Cal-GETC list.

notes: Completing the Golden Four alone does not make a student eligible: the unit, GE-unit, GPA and good-standing minimums also apply.
Following this route does not certify Cal-GETC; remaining lower-division and upper-division GE is completed after transfer.
Campus and major supplemental criteria (impaction, major preparation, deadlines for completing the Golden Four) vary; confirm them with the campus.
